recipe.description: These easy, budget-friendly chicken quesadillas make a quick lunch for two or a simple party snack and are a great way to use up leftover roast chicken
recipe.name: Chicken quesadillas
recipe.headline: Chicken quesadillas
recipe.keywords: Chicken, Coriander, Cutting waste, Easy snacks, How to use up leftover chicken, Kidney bean, Kidney beans, Leftover roast chicken recipes, Mature cheddar, Quesadillas, Quick, Salsa, Sara Buenfeld, Spring onion, Spring onions, Tortilla, Tortillas
recipeIngredient: 4 tbsp hot salsa from a jar
2 large flour tortillas seeded or plain
215g can kidney beans drained and roughly mashed
50g leftover roast chicken shredded (use the last of the meat on the carcass)
½ a 20g pack coriander leaves chopped (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: Spread 2 tbsp salsa onto each tortilla, then evenly top one of them with the beans, spring onion, chicken and cheddar. Scatter with coriander, if you have it. Sandwich with the other tortilla, then brush with oil.

Heat a large non-stick frying pan, then cook the tortilla, oil-side down, for 4 mins. Carefully turn over with a palette knife (or by turning it out onto a plate, sliding it back into the pan), then cook for 2 mins on the other side until golden. Serve cut into wedges.

Method
step 1
Spread 2 tbsp salsa onto each tortilla, then evenly top one of them with the beans, spring onion, chicken and cheddar. Scatter with coriander, if you have it. Sandwich with the other tortilla, then brush with oil.
step 2
Heat a large non-stick frying pan, then cook the tortilla, oil-side down, for 4 mins. Carefully turn over with a palette knife (or by turning it out onto a plate, sliding it back into the pan), then cook for 2 mins on the other side until golden. Serve cut into wedges.
RECIPE TIPS
ALTERNATIVE FILLING IDEA
Mix leftover roast chicken with grated cheese,
mango chutney and chopped spring onions.
SERVING TIP
Try serving your tortillas with sliced
avocado and coriander tossed in a little
lime juice.
